item.title: More Luxury Apartments Come To Winchester
item.description: A new 283-unit apartment building in Science Park expects to welcome its first tenants later this month -- advancing a years-long project of redeveloping the former Winchester Arms factory complex into homes, stores, and bioscience labs. item.title: City’s Top Lawyer To Resign
item.description: Corporation Counsel Patricia King will step down from her role as the city's top attorney at the end of this week -- after a six-year tenure that saw the city weather the novel legal challenges of the Covid pandemic, the second Trump administration, and a police-misconduct lawsuit that ended with a $45 million settlement. The post City’s Top Lawyer To Resign appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Ribbon Cut On New Bus Ticket Sales Outlet
item.description: City and state officials celebrated on Monday the opening of a new outlet to buy bus passes downtown -- at a location where employees will be able to stay warm indoors, though wheelchair users and others who can't climb a step will have to wait outside. The post Ribbon Cut On New Bus Ticket Sales Outlet appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Police Chief Retires After Theft Confrontation
item.description: (Updated) New Haven Police Chief Karl Jacobson abruptly resigned and retired Monday amid allegations that he stole money from the department's account for paying confidential informants.
